function.name: GET_PIXEL
function.abstract: Read the value of a pixel of a graph

description.p: This function recovers the colour of a determined pixel of the background of the screen. The coordinates increase towards up and right, and the point (0, 0) represents the top left corner of the screen.

In the case of the graph mode of 256 colours (8 bits), the value returned by this function is a colour among 0 and 255. In the case of the mode of 16 bits, the value returned is a codification of the components of the colour which depends of the video card and the graph mode. It can use to obtain the approximated values of the components of the colour.
This function is equivalent to MAP_GET_PIXEL (0, 0, x, y).

function.note: It is possible to use a background of 8 bits in a game that works in mode of 16 bits. Normally, Fenix detects when it happens. For example, a game that use with a map of 8 bits makes create in background of screen of 8 bits. However, once time we use a function like with a graph of 16 bits, the background becomes to 16 bits. It is important to know this because sometimes GET_PIXEL can return a value among 0 and 255, although it is working in 16 bits. If you want to be secure that the depth of colour has the background of screen, you should use the function with the map 0, 0 and the parameter G_DEPTH.
